title: Human prostate cancer bone metastases have an actionable immunosuppressive microenvironment
description: We collected unique sets of tissue fractions from each patient: solid metastatic tissue (Tumor fraction), liquid bone marrow at the site of the metastasis (Involved), as well as liquid bone marrow from a vertebral body distant from the tumor site (Distal). This allowed for a comparison within the same individual, controlling for inter-individual variation. Bone marrow samples from patients undergoing hip replacement surgery (Benign) served as a non-malignant comparator group. The transcriptional composition of all samples was assessed using single-cell RNA-seq (scRNA-seq). Overall design: Bone marrow were disaggregated and profiled by 10X Genomics Single cell 3 gene expression V2. **The records have been updated with raw data for samples GSM4274678-GSM4274709 on May 12, 2022.
